inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Repair the lower half of an existing pixel art battle background, keeping its exact palette, light, scale and oblique 2.5D camera. This is the open fighting ground of a ruined burial grove. Everything tall stays behind it: the giant dead root tree, its roots and a small dark seep pool end at the tree's foot, the low walls and ruins stand at the back. In front of them the ground is flat and open all the way to the bottom: cracked ash earth on the far left turning into worn pale flagstones with ash in the joints. Only flat details: thin cracks, a few flat broken slabs, tiny flat pebbles, thin dry roots lying flat. Calm and readable, because fighters stand here.
